claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean sign under an interior product bias and every physical block A, L_A=M_A+J_A and 0<=J_A<=M_A+Delta_A, with Delta_A=sum_i[h2(p_i)+log2 max(p_i,1-p_i)].
dependencies: Boolean Parseval for every physical child
Shannon chain rule and mutual information

claims.statement: For g(X,Y)=(-1)^(XY), P(X=1)=p and fixed P(Y=1)=q in (0,1/2), revealing X gives J-M=4q(1-2q)p log2(1/p)+O(p). Consequently every universal J<=M+C p fails and every universal J<=M+kappa Delta requires kappa>=1/2.
